title: Kickoff call
summary: Devendra explained that SkillBridge wants to sell recorded versions of its classroom courses to students in nearby towns. Decisions: one-time payment per course through Stripe (no subscriptions), lecture videos will be YouTube unlisted links, the theme is blue and white matching the centre's signboard, and the launch will have 8 courses with four teacher accounts. The first demo is on 24 July. Open question: Devendra wants the site on his GoDaddy domain, which also runs the centre's business email; how this will be done was not discussed in detail.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: Good evening Devendra sir. I am Farhan, the mentor for this project. Meenakshi and Pooja are the developers.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Good evening. Sorry for the late timing, classes go on till six.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: No problem sir. We read your note. Could you tell us in your own words what you want the platform to do for your students?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: See, we have students coming from Baramati, Satara, even Solapur side. They stay in a hostel for three months just for our spoken English batch. If I can give the same course recorded, they can learn from home and pay less. That is the idea.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: So a student should find a course, pay once and then watch all the lectures. Is that right? Or do you want monthly payment?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: One time only. Monthly is a headache, parents will call every month. Pay once, course is yours.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: Okay sir. We will use Stripe for payment. When payment is successful, Stripe informs our server and the student gets enrolled automatically.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Fine, fine. My CA already made the Stripe account. As long as money comes to the centre's account.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: About the videos. Hosting video files ourselves is costly. Our suggestion is to upload them to YouTube as unlisted and play them inside the site.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Unlisted means nobody can search it? Then okay. Our teachers already know how to upload on YouTube.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: How are your courses arranged, sir? Do they have units or modules?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Yes. Take Tally. There are six units, each unit has five or six classes. Same for spoken English, it goes week by week.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: Good, that matches our design. A course has chapters, and each chapter has lectures. We can also mark one lecture as a free preview.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Free preview is a very good idea. Parents want to see before paying.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: How many courses and teachers at the start?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Eight courses. Four teachers will upload. I will not upload anything myself, I only want to see how many students joined.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: And for the colours and logo?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Blue and white, same as our signboard. I will WhatsApp you the logo. Keep the English simple, please. Many of these children are buying something online for the first time.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: One important thing. We have our own domain from GoDaddy, our email is also on it, all staff use it. The site must come on that domain only. Not some strange link.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: Yes sir, we can connect it at the time of going live. We will need access to the domain settings then.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: I will give you the GoDaddy password, no issue. Just see that email should not stop. We get admissions enquiries on it every day.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: Noted. We will plan that step carefully nearer to launch. First demo will be on 24 July with course browsing and the player.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: 24 July, okay. Evening time please.

title: Progress update
summary: The team demoed the course list, course details page, player and test payments. Devendra said several times that the site 'feels slow and non-responsive' but could not say which page or device; he mentioned both his phone and the office desktop, and both the course page and scrolling. Decisions: course prices will be shown in rupees with the discount percentage visible, the educator dashboard will show total earnings and enrolled students only, and go-live on the GoDaddy domain is planned for 25 September. Open questions: what exactly is slow, and how to point the domain to the site without disturbing the business email.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: Good evening sir. Today we will show the full student journey: find a course, pay with a test card and watch a lecture.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Yes, I have been opening the link you sent. Overall good. But I will tell you frankly, it feels slow and non-responsive.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: Thank you for telling us, sir. Where did you feel it? On which page?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Generally. I opened it on my phone at home and it was not nice. Things were not coming properly. Then in office on the computer also I felt it takes time. The Tally course page especially, I think. Or maybe the first page. I don't remember exactly.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: Sir, was it taking time to open, or was it opening but the layout was looking wrong on the phone?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Both I think? It is just not smooth. When I scroll it is stuck-stuck. My nephew also said uncle, it is not responsive. He knows computers. You check it, you will understand.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: We will look into it. Devendra sir, which phone do you use, if you don't mind?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: It is a Redmi, two or three years old. But students will have the same type of phone only, so it must work on that.

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: Understood sir. Let me continue the demo. This is the course details page. Chapters open and close, and the lecture with the Preview label can be watched free.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Good. Price is showing in dollars here?

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: That is from the sample data, sir. We will set the currency to rupees. Do you want to show the discount also?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Yes. Rupees, and show the cut price with percentage off. Parents like to see discount. Tally will be 2,999 with 20 percent off.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: Okay. Now payment. I pay with the test card, Stripe sends the confirmation to our server, and the course comes in My Enrollments.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: That was fast. Nice. And the teacher side?

segments.speaker: Student (Meenakshi)
segments.text: Teachers can add a course with chapters and lectures, and see their students. For the dashboard, what do you want to see, sir?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Only two things. Total money earned and how many students enrolled, course-wise. Nothing fancy.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: Good, that is clear. On the domain, we are planning to go live on 25 September. We will need DNS access about a week before.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: 25 September is fine, new batch starts in October. I will send the GoDaddy login on WhatsApp. You do whatever is needed, change whatever. Only our email should not get disturbed, last time a fellow touched something and mail was down for two days.

segments.speaker: Student (Pooja)
segments.text: Sir, do you know where your email is hosted? Is it GoDaddy's own email or Google?

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: That I don't know. We open it in Outlook. My office boy Ganesh set it up, I will ask him.

segments.speaker: Mentor (Farhan)
segments.text: Please do. So, decisions: prices in rupees with discount shown, educator dashboard with earnings and enrolled students, go-live on 25 September. We will investigate the slowness and come back.

segments.speaker: Client (Devendra)
segments.text: Yes. Please make it fast and responsive, that is my main feedback. Rest is good.
